title: TraceEvo Model Invocation
description: One LLM call that actually happened, whether or not its response became a provenance event. The second observability channel: S2.1's A4 injections were absorbed at GoS's decision/content seam and produced no event, so a trace-only audit could not see them.

call_id.description: unique per task; assigned at open_call

prompt_hash.description: sha256 of the request key (model + messages + temperature); identical to the recording key, so a ledger row and a recorded call can be joined

parent_event_id.description: latest provenance event at open time

parse_status.description: `pending` between open_call and the parser reporting back; a run that dies in between leaves it `pending`

emitted_text_hash.description: sha256 of the text the parser extracted, used to bind an event to its call exactly

binding.description: `text` = the committed text hashes to this call's emitted text; `positional` = no text was available and the most recent accepted call was used instead, which is a weaker claim
